  "schema_version": 1,
  "candidate_id": "geometry-poincare-residual-sid-v2",
  "behavior_problem_id": "directional-next-item-transition-with-high-nonreverse-rate",
  "behavior_evidence_sha256": "793d52dce39a5a8aa3963ff566ae50612114b9d20d31227dfed3d1e9fc653b9b",
  "literature_evidence_sha256": "8ba6837c216074f407682b678f8b30acb30e89d57086da57dd7a4d6a599d9d0d",
  "next_item_hypothesis": "The demonstrated failure is that a content-only item code can merge distinct successors of an anchor into indistinguishable first-level neighborhoods, despite train-only directed transition structure: 314605 of 339519 transitions have no observed reverse event (0.9266197178950221), with mean next-item entropy 4.844072338042215 bits. Hypothesis: negative curvature gives a shared bounded representation more capacity for branching, non-reversible successor neighborhoods than a flat metric, improving the item's hierarchical codes and ultimately Stage3 next-item ranking. These descriptive statistics do not establish curvature necessity or causal improvement. Stage2 creates one global three-token SID per item from content; it does not rank, condition on user context, or use validation/test behavior.",
  "math_definition": {
    "builder": "For each item i, fixed content embedding e_i is mapped by the same frozen architecture f_theta to z_i in R^32. Quantize a three-level residual code: at level j form residual r_i^(1)=z_i and, for j=1,2,3, map u_i^(j)=P_R(r_i^(j)), assign k_ij=argmin_{k in {1,...,256}} D_c^2(u_i^(j), q_jk), then subtract the selected code in the shared Euclidean coordinates, r_i^(j+1)=r_i^(j)-q_j,k_ij. Thus operation order at every residual level is MAP residual -> PROJECT -> ASSIGN by scored squared distance -> SUBTRACT selected code; subtraction is not projected until the next level's map-then-project step. The projection applies to every vector entering a distance, including mapped residuals and code vectors; q_jk are constrained to ||q_jk||<=R after each optimizer update. At level 1 the only conditioning is content; level 2 conditions exactly on earlier code k_i1 through the residual; level 3 conditions exactly on earlier codes (k_i1,k_i2) through the residual. The global SID is (k_i1,k_i2,k_i3), shared across all occurrences of item i.",
    "geometry": {
      "shared_representation_map": "P_R(x)=x*min(1,R/||x||), with P_R(0)=0 and the same frozen R=0.99 in both arms. This is the only map before assignment and is curvature-independent. No exponential map or curvature-dependent transform is used. All code vectors and all vectors entering distance are in this same fixed Euclidean ball ||x||<=R<1.",
      "curvature": 0.1,
      "epsilon": 1e-7,
      "clamp_and_domain_policy": "For nonidentical x,y, compute u=2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)), clamp u below by epsilon only inside arcosh evaluation, and use arcosh(1+max(u,epsilon)); for exactly identical x=y return D^2=0 exactly, bypassing the clamp. R=0.99 ensures positive denominators for c=0.1. The same epsilon and exact-coincidence convention are used in the c=0 arm's stable shared implementation, whose analytic limit bypasses arcosh.",
      "scored_distance": "D^2(x,y)=d_c(x,y)^2=(1/c)*arcosh(1+2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)))^2. The objective and assignments use the squared power D^2 in both arms. Numerically evaluate arcosh(1+t) as log1p(t+sqrt(t*(t+2))) for t>=0 after the stated clamp, with exact zero handled separately. As c->0, D^2 tends exactly to 4*||x-y||^2; the unsquared distance tends to 2*||x-y||.",
      "c_dependent_rules_and_limits": "The scored-distance rule is c-dependent and has the c->0 limit 4*||x-y||^2 (unsquared distance 2*||x-y||). The exponential map is not used in either arm; if represented as an identity operation in implementation, its c->0 limit and value at every c are the identity. The radius (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) is not used: it is undefined at c=0 and therefore the flat arm applies the common fixed projection P_R with R=0.99 instead. The shared map and projection have no other c-dependent rule. No c-dependent residual update is used.",
      "flat_arm": "One implementation parameterized by c uses c=0.1 for curved and c=0 for flat. The flat branch evaluates the exact distance limit 4*||x-y||^2; shared content encoder, projection, code assignment logic, code parameters, residual subtraction, losses, initialization, and all other operations are identical. Only the distance expression changes."
    },
    "objective": {
      "anti_collapse": "The item reconstruction term is the anti-collapse mechanism: each item's content-derived z_i is required to remain close to its detached three-code reconstruction, so assigning every item the same SID incurs content-dependent residual error. It enters additively in the Stage2 loss as L_rec with positive weight 1; train-transition supervision and commitment are auxiliary and cannot replace this term.",
      "loss_equations": [
        "Let I be the train-split item set, B=|I|, z_i=f_theta(e_i) in R^32, q_jk in R^32, and a_ij=stopgrad(q_j,k_ij). Define reconstruction xhat_i=sum_{j=1}^3 a_ij and L_rec=(1/B)*sum_{i in I} D_c^2(P_R(z_i),P_R(xhat_i)). Each sum is normalized by B; if I is empty the run is invalid, not zero loss.",
        "Let L_commit=(1/(3B))*sum_{i in I} sum_{j=1}^3 D_c^2(P_R(r_i^(j)), stopgrad(P_R(q_j,k_ij))). The target code vector is detached, while the residual-side encoder path receives gradients. If B=0, the run is invalid.",
        "Let T be the multiset of adjacent (anchor item a, successor item b) transitions from train-split sequences only, and S_a={b':(a,b') occurs in T}; remove b from S_a when forming negatives. For each (a,b) choose the lowest-ID item in I\{a,b} as deterministic negative n(a,b), omitting the example if none exists. With s_i=concat(onehot(k_i1),onehot(k_i2),onehot(k_i3)), define L_trans=(1/|T'|)*sum_{(a,b) in T'} max(0, 1 - cos(s_a,s_b) + cos(s_a,s_n(a,b))), where T' is the retained set and cosine uses epsilon 1e-12 in both norms. If T' is empty, define L_trans=0.",
        "The sole scalar objective is L=L_rec+0.25*L_commit+0.1*L_trans. The transition term uses only train-split item transitions and is assignment supervision, not a Stage2 ranking objective. All losses are arithmetic means over their stated index sets."
      ],
      "assignment_target_circularity": "Hard assignments are computed from current parameters by the stated argmin, treated as nondifferentiable indices for the update; the selected vectors in reconstruction targets and commitment targets are stop-gradient. Thus no target gradient flows through its own assignment or target code vector."
    },
    "diagnostics": {
      "definitions": "Use the frozen definitions verbatim: valid L1 positive hit rate over 52855 frozen validation pairs (one positive plus ten negatives per anchor, seed 42, history[-1] -> target), share whose anchor item's first SID token equals the positive's first token; valid Hard-L1 ER=10*positive_hits/negative_hits with negative_hits counted identically over the ten negatives; level2_distinct_prefixes=|{(k1,k2)}| over all items; L3 collision=share of items whose (k1,k2,k3) is shared with another item; L3 refinement gain=mean over items log2(|bucket(k1,k2)|/|bucket(k1,k2,k3)|); conditional G3 as the supplied alpha=1,K=256 estimator, where p_pref(l)=(count of items sharing target's level-two prefix with third code l, minus one only for target's own third code, plus alpha)/(bucket size minus one plus alpha*K), p_hist(l)=(train-only longest-prefix successor count of anchor restricted to successors sharing target's level-two prefix and third code l, plus alpha*p_pref(l))/(restricted successor total plus alpha); mean log2(p_hist(target third code)/p_pref(target third code)); no restricted successor contributes 0 and non-finite pair is NULL. No definition is changed.",
      "validation_role": "These metrics are diagnostic-only. Validation pairs and validation behavior do not enter fitting, code assignment, target construction, or SID creation."
    }
  },
  "hyperbolic_necessity": "Negative curvature is a motivated hypothesis because the measured train-only transition graph is strongly directional and successor targets have nontrivial entropy: a branching neighborhood can expand more rapidly with radius in negatively curved space than in flat space. This may reduce collisions among distinct successor branches under a fixed-depth code hierarchy. Neither the behavior evidence nor the cited literature proves necessity; the cited generative semantic-ID work supports semantic-ID recommendation only, and the supplied hyperbolic overlap is unverified. Necessity is therefore tested only by the matched metric ablation and registered downstream test.",
  "euclidean_control": "The control is the identical c-parameterized implementation at c=0. Both arms use exactly the same P_R, latent and code parameterization, code assignments, residual updates, content inputs, train-only transition signal, loss, optimizer, initialization, schedule, seeds, and compute budget. No arm-specific map, projection, codebook, or target change is permitted; only the scored squared distance is replaced by its exact c->0 expression.",
  "effect_site": "Stage2 assignment and reconstruction/commitment geometry, with expected leading changes in L3 collision, L3 refinement gain, conditional G3, and prefix diversity; eventual behavioral effect is measured only by downstream Stage3 T5 ranking.",
  "real_trigger_measurement": "The trigger is train-only longest-prefix transition evidence: directed_pairs=323633, transitions=339519, no_observed_reverse_events=314605, no_reverse_fraction=0.9266197178950221, and mean_next_item_entropy_bits=4.844072338042215. These are descriptive statistics from the frozen manifest, not causal evidence.",
  "training_only_inputs": "Stage2 may use item content embeddings and adjacent transitions from the train split only. No validation/test behavior, future event, prediction-time user context, or batch composition enters fitting, targets, assignments, or global SID construction. Validation is diagnostic-only; test interactions are used only for the registered Stage3 evaluation.",
  "stable_global_sid": true,
  "protocol": {
    "latent_dim": 32,
    "levels": 3,
    "codes_per_level": 256,
    "hyperparameter_sweep": false,
    "uses_future_events": false,
    "epochs": 3000,
    "batch_size": "frozen existing Stage2 batch size; unchanged in both arms",
    "optimizer_schedule": "frozen existing Stage2 optimizer and schedule; unchanged in both arms",
    "seeds": "frozen existing Stage2 seed set; paired identical seeds in both arms",
    "codebook_initialization": "frozen existing Stage2 codebook initialization; identical paired initialization in both arms",
    "compute_budget": "identical frozen Stage2 budget in both arms",
    "forbidden_components": ["prefix Transformer", "beam search", "NDCG/Recall in Stage2", "user bootstrap", "new training protocol"]
  },
  "falsifier": {
    "stage2_diagnostics": [
      {"name": "valid_l1_hard_er", "direction": "curved > flat and strictly above the frozen Resample reference", "minimum_effect": "curved value strictly greater than 16.38953942232631", "seed_rule": "For each frozen paired seed compute curved-minus-flat; require every seed difference > 0 and arithmetic mean of seed-wise curved values > 16.38953942232631. No weighting; seeds equally weighted."},
      {"name": "level2_distinct_prefixes", "direction": "curved > flat and strictly above frozen threshold", "minimum_effect": "curved value strictly greater than 16145", "seed_rule": "For each frozen paired seed compute curved-minus-flat; require every seed difference > 0 and arithmetic mean of seed-wise curved values > 16145.       {"name": "L3 collision", "direction": "curved < flat", "minimum_effect": "arithmetic mean paired reduction at least 0.01 absolute", "seed_rule": "Compute flat minus curved per paired seed; require every seed difference > 0 and arithmetic mean difference >= 0.01; seeds equally weighted."},
      {"name": "L3 refinement gain", "direction": "curved > flat", "minimum_effect": "arithmetic mean paired increase at least 0.10 bits", "seed_rule": "Compute curved minus flat per paired seed; require every seed difference > 0 and arithmetic mean difference >= 0.10 bits; seeds equally weighted."},
      {"name": "conditional G3", "direction": "curved > flat", "minimum_effect": "arithmetic mean paired increase at least 0.05 bits", "seed_rule": "Compute curved minus flat per paired seed using the frozen G3 estimator; require every seed difference > 0 and arithmetic mean difference >= 0.05 bits; seeds equally weighted."}
    ],
    "stage3_behavioral_test": {
      "metric": "test_R@10",
      "direction": "curved > flat",
      "minimum_effect": "arithmetic mean paired absolute increase at least 0.005",
      "seed_rule": "Use the frozen Stage3 test evaluation protocol on identical paired seeds; for each seed compute curved test_R@10 minus flat test_R@10, then take the unweighted arithmetic mean of those per-seed differences. Require this mean >= 0.005. No other metric is substituted."
    },
    "classification": {
      "falsified_if": "any registered diagnostic or Stage3 behavioral test has a defined aggregate in the opposite direction, or fails its registered minimum_effect; thresholds and comparison rules are exactly those registered in stage2_diagnostics and stage3_behavioral_test",
      "passed_if": "all five registered Stage2 diagnostics and the registered Stage3 behavioral test satisfy their registered direction and minimum_effect with no NULL seed; thresholds and comparison rules are exactly those registered in stage2_diagnostics and stage3_behavioral_test",
      "mixed_if": "at least one registered Stage2 diagnostic satisfies its registered direction and minimum_effect and at least one registered Stage2 diagnostic or Stage3 behavioral test fails its registered direction or minimum_effect, with no NULL seed; thresholds and comparison rules are exactly those registered in stage2_diagnostics and stage3_behavioral_test"
    },
    "null_outcome_rule": "If a seed-wise or aggregated change is undefined or non-finite (including zero denominator, missing evaluation, or empty stratum), classify that outcome NULL. Any comparison containing any NULL seed is inconclusive, neither passed nor falsified; do not impute or drop that seed."
  }
}
